fact: Tchad Vision reports that on 4 December 2024 the Minister of Public Health chaired the validation of the national digital health strategic plan for 2025-2030 and signed its preface, and that the ministry's Secretary-General put the cost of implementing it at more than seven billion CFA francs; the article names no system and no source of finance.
title: Lancement d'un plan stratégique ambitieux pour la santé numérique
